directAnswerFaqs.q: How does Gyan VaniAi compare to Wati, Respond.io, and AiSensy?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi combines native Meta WhatsApp Coexistence (keeping your mobile app active), 0% Meta conversation markup, sub-300ms RAG chatbots, native full-duplex Voice AI calling, and optional 100% IP-owned custom engineering.

directAnswerFaqs.q: What are Gyan VaniAi Transparent Engineering Partnerships?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Fixed-timeline engineering engagements with 100% IP ownership: Tier 01 Meta WhatsApp & AI Helpdesk Setup (₹24,999 / $299 in 5 days), Tier 02 AI CRM, Voice & Hybrid RAG Sprint (₹69,999 / $850 in 14 days), and Tier 03 Full Enterprise AI & Meta Tech Suite (Custom Scope, 4 to 8 weeks).

directAnswerFaqs.q: How does Gyan VaniAi support Indian businesses?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi provides native UPI payment links, GST-compliant invoicing, DLT template registration guidance, bilingual Hindi/English voice bots, and DPDP Act 2023 compliance.

directAnswerFaqs.q: What is Model Context Protocol (MCP) in Gyan VaniAi?
directAnswerFaqs.a: Gyan VaniAi implements Model Context Protocol (MCP) to standardize how AI agents securely discover and invoke internal CRM tools, database queries, and external APIs with granular permission enforcement.
